description: Probabilistic linear classifier based on Bayes' theorem with the 'naive' independence assumption between features. Uses smoothing (alpha) to handle unseen tokens.
why_tested: Baseline linear method covered at mid-semester; fast, interpretable, and a standard text-classification reference.
input_features: Sparse word unigram/bigram TF-IDF (max_features=60000, min_df=2, max_df=0.99, sublinear_tf=True). Negation tokens such as 'not' and 'without' are kept as ordinary tokens.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/naive_bayes/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + vectorizer.joblib + metadata.json). Encoder/transformer weights are not used.
